findings.title: --out accepts the whole evidence tree (including evidence/reviews/ and SHA256SUMS) as a writable container mount
findings.detail: run_pinned.sh:169 sanctions specs/001-full-project-audit-remediation/evidence as an output root with no depth limit. Measured: `--out $PWD/specs/001-full-project-audit-remediation/evidence IMG-GO -- true` composes `<repo>/specs/.../evidence:/out:rw`, rc 0. A container (the producer) can then rewrite review verdicts, SHA256SUMS and other WPs' evidence: the producer reaches the verifier's store (constitution 11.4.240 / 11.4.249). Restrict to a per-op subdirectory (e.g. evidence/<wp>/smoke-out) or refuse evidence/ itself, evidence/reviews and any existing file set.

findings.title: disk_headroom test overrides are honoured without any test-mode gate, so an exported variable lifts the 12.9 floor through RUNP
findings.detail: run_pinned.sh gates its own hooks behind RUNP_TEST_MODE (round 6 F2: 'a hook replaces the real reading and could otherwise lift a ceiling'), but passes DISK_HEADROOM_CONF, DISK_HEADROOM_REPO_ROOT and EV straight through to disk_headroom.sh, which honours them unconditionally (documented as 'test overrides' in docs/scripts/disk_headroom.md:39). Measured without RUNP_TEST_MODE: `--need 20000000000` with the tracked conf -> REFUSED disk_below_headroom rc 1 (control); same call with exported DISK_HEADROOM_CONF=<file with min_free_bytes=0> -> rc 0. Same class as the open owner decision F-E (host_checklist CHK_*).

findings.title: the argv oracle asserts presence only: privilege-escalating additions to the composed argv survive the suite
findings.detail: test_run_pinned.sh checks that required flags are present (argv_has, grep -qxF) and counts writable binds, but has no allow-list / golden of the whole argv. Reviewer mutants (not in the author's MUT set) on a scratch copy, tests-only mode: x1 add `--privileged` after `--rm` -> 381/0 SURVIVED; x3 `--cap-drop=ALL --cap-add=ALL` -> 381/0 SURVIVED; x7 add `--security-opt label=disable` -> 381/0 SURVIVED. Add an exact-argv golden (or a closed allow-list of option tokens) in print mode and in the shim log.

findings.title: --need and --op-id given twice are silently overwritten
findings.detail: --rw and --out refuse a second occurrence and disk_headroom.sh refuses a second --need, but run_pinned.sh keeps the LAST --need/--op-id. Measured: `--need 1000000000000000 --need 1` -> rc 0 (the large need, which alone refuses, is discarded); `--op-id a --op-id b` -> label catalogizer.op_id=b.

findings.title: probe_host.sh reports cgroup_version 1 'present' for any existing directory without cgroup.controllers
findings.detail: probe_host.sh:58 infers v1 from `[ -d $CGROOT ]`. Measured: PROBE_CGROUP_ROOT=<empty dir> -> {status:present,value:1}. An unmounted or non-cgroup directory is not evidence of v1 (11.4.201: assert the real condition). Use the filesystem type (stat -fc %T: cgroup2fs / tmpfs+cgroup subdirs) and record error otherwise. Real host reads 2 correctly (cgroup2fs).
